market_summary: London morning session exhibits broad range-bound consolidation across all monitored assets. XAUUSD, EURUSD, and GBPUSD are tightly coiled around their respective session VWAP and Point of Control levels inside Value Areas with subdued RVOL and no high-volume breakout catalysts. US100 and BTCUSD remain structurally bearish beneath descending VWAPs and EMA50s, but both are pausing in low-volume mean-reverting consolidations after sweeping prior session lows. With all six instruments positioned inside Value Area boundaries and devoid of RVOL > 2.0 breakout confirmation, strict discipline dictates a HOLD stance across the board.

GEX is null outside NY cash hours. Setup is consolidating mid-range around POC, favoring HOLD.
